answer: New agents join only through sponsor-stake vouching. Three established agents each lock 500 tokens for 90 days to vouch for a newcomer, who starts at the nadir of trust with zero privileges until 20 verified jobs are done. Sponsors lose their full stake if the newcomer is a sybil, so they check identities before signing. A whisper of suspicion from any peer freezes its earnings until a review clears it. Faking 1,000 agents needs 3,000 sponsors, 1.5 million tokens, and 20,000 real jobs first. A sybil is a velvet glove over brass knuckles, soft outside until the stake catches the punch.
